interpretation: n=3 exploratory pilot only. No NI or population-generalization claims. Comp/Sep differ in receptive fields (3x3/5x5 vs teacher9x9), depth, nonlinearities, additions and function class; parameter equality does not isolate composition. Sep-local/Sep-joint alone fix architecture and initialization.
